role: Independent AI pixel/arrow review; not a human participant or publication acceptance

method.inspection: Native screenshot viewed with view_image at original resolution, then a 2x raster crop of the canvas center viewed separately.

crop.purpose: Magnify existing pixels only; this is not an independent capture or higher-resolution proof.

method.declaredWorkload: 9 modules and 7 connections: manually authored 4-module chain plus appended minimum MLP preset

observations.result: Two separated horizontal chains fit inside the canvas without card-body overlap, edge/body collision, unnecessary crossings or bends in this static state.

All seven visible connections follow the aligned horizontal port rows. Output/input circles are distinguishable in the crop; the direction marker is very small at the native 45% screenshot, so rapid direction recognition is weaker than endpoint association.

Both ReLU node headers display an intentional-looking 'ReLU ...' ellipsis; the body operator remains ReLU. Other visible headers and operator names fit. Native port and operator labels are tiny at 45%, which limits novice reading at this zoom. No visible text overlaps adjacent cards.

The module library shows 17 base modules and 3 network starting points, with visible minimum MLP, small CNN and residual MLP cards. The right properties pane is scrollable and the bottom helper text is partly below the captured viewport; this screenshot does not prove omitted controls are absent.
The top and bottom of the UI visibly state that the draft has unsaved changes, and the bottom notice asks the user to save or reset before creating a new empty model.

assessment: No obvious visual disorder in the captured authoring state; low-zoom label and arrow readability remain limited.
limits: Static authoring screenshot only; it does not independently prove gestures, four-direction movement, undo, recovery or export behavior.
The two visible chains are disconnected in this state. This is consistent with appending a preset, but connectivity validity must be checked separately.
This review cannot count toward the real researcher or human publication-review gate.
